name: Marked For Mayhem
description:
About This Game

Enter Galus’s fractured reality, where multiple dimensions converge. The wake of the cataclysm has bred not only resilience but a new form of entertainment. You and your rival Operators must embark on missions across shattered dimensions to take down the most feared enemies on Galus.

There’s just one problem.

Only one Operator can win. Let the chaos commence!

You’re not just here to get the job done. You’re fighting for the glory of first place. 

Master an array of unique and iconic weaponry and conquer an interdimensional competition built around combat, spectacle, and havoc. Every mission throws Operators into a mix of enemy encounters, competitive events, and showstopping boss battles, all while the show keeps score and the crowds roar for more!

HAVEN, the most powerful and advanced organization on Galus, brings you a chance for glory and immortality. All for the pleasure of the viewing public, naturally.

Medals are earned throughout each mission, turning every encounter into a battle for position on the leaderboard. A great Operator knows when to focus on taking down enemies and when to sabotage your rivals.

Don’t just outperform your rivals in combat. Win adrenaline-filled arena games, mindspace challenges, and traversal time trials, head-to-head challenges that see you and your rivals compete throughout each run. Seize opportunities and steal advantages when the moment presents itself.

Choose your weapon at the start of each mission, master its abilities, and shape your upgrades into a powerful build for that run. Purchase new abilities and modifiers that let you shape the power of your chosen weapon. After the match dust settles, upgrade your drone with modifications that augment your abilities and can give you new advantages in battle.

Adapt to what you find as you experiment with different builds and item combinations. Chase synergistic upgrades to deal devastating damage and turn every run into a new opportunity to cause mayhem.

Marked for Mayhem combines action combat with multiplayer dungeon encounters designed around challenging enemies that the Operators must master. Bosses demand skill, positioning, timing, and firepower. The perfect time to show off your skills.

But after all, you’re in this for yourself, right? So don’t just defeat Galus’ most fearsome enemies, but use timing and skill to redirect their abilities against your rivals.

Seize key moments in the heat of battle to one-up your opponents with powerful abilities known as Disruptors.

These abilities can change the course of the match by dealing damage when aimed at your rivals. Even if you don't have the build that deals the biggest bang, you can still come out on top in a combat round if you use your disruptors well.
short_desc: Enter a shattered world where dimensions collide in this competitive 4-player action dungeon runner. Defeat and leverage diverse bosses, win chaotic challenges, master your build around unique weapons, and sabotage your rivals to take the top spot. The mission is shared. The glory isn’t.
